title: Feature Request: Hold Shift to Launch Multiple Apps from Application Dashboard
line: Holding Shift while launching an app from Application Dashboard now keeps the dashboard open, so several apps can be opened in a row.
explanation: Every launch from the Application Dashboard emitted interactionConcluded, which always closed it, and the dashboard also closes whenever it stops being the active window, which happens as soon as the new app's window appears (KWin activates new windows at the default focus stealing prevention level). Clicks on the grid items reach QML without keyboard modifiers, so there was no way to tell whether Shift was held. DashboardWindow now exposes the current keyboard modifiers; when an app is launched with Shift held, the dashboard stays open and, when the new window takes the focus, raises itself and takes the focus back instead of closing.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: let the dashboard read the keyboard modifiers

Clicks on the Application Dashboard's grid items don't carry keyboard
modifiers to QML, so it can't tell whether Shift was held when an app
was launched. Expose the current modifiers on DashboardWindow for that.

BUG: 451796

applets/kicker: keep the dashboard open when launching apps with Shift

Every launch from the Application Dashboard closed it, so opening many
apps meant reopening it each time. When Shift is held, the dashboard now
stays open and takes the focus back from the window of the launched app.

BUG: 451796
